title: fix(pm): the leading-sigil near-miss regex refuses a long symbol run in linear time, so the live half-state sweep no longer hangs on a drawn rule
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao9PQd2u5bJDrRzXPyw7pZaq)_

Fixes #32991

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:半状态巡查脚本里一条识别「符号开头的认领/释放行」的正则,换成等价但不会回溯爆炸的写法;工作流 `timeout-minutes` 15 → 25,并在注释里写明依据与 ⛔ 不得为挂起而加大上限。
- 为什么改:超时不是看板变大,而是 #32929 上一条评论画了四行 40 个「─」的分隔线,旧正则在这种行上要尝试约 2 的 40 次方种切分,CPU 卡死,巡查被 15 分钟上限取消。另外实测 10-30 至 11-09 的 43 次绿跑里最慢 14m02s,离 15 分钟只差 58 秒,所以上限一并放到 25(约最慢一次的 1.78 倍)。
- 风险与回滚:新旧正则在 31 万多条字符串上匹配结果完全一致;自测新增 28 字符计时钉(<250 ms),旧写法下按名变红而不是挂住。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看:`scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` 的 `leading-sigil` 一行正则与 BATTERY68 三条 #32991 用例;`.github/workflows/half-state-patrol.yml` 的上限注释。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs --self-test`,应见 5256 cases pass,含三条 #32991 用例。
- 需要你做的:本 PR 改动了持有密钥/写令牌的工作流(Tier H)。契约复审在现 head 已 PASS(评论 6848055804,Head-sha `0b448a73ae6c6f63d66fb558237923cefc682c44`),请以 os-zhuang 批准;批准后席位落地。
- 席位意见:同意落地。本 PR 不走派发时的 A/B 任一分支(根因是正则 ReDoS,不是看板增长),上限 25 也由席位确认,两项作为接受的偏差记在 ACCEPT 里。本 head 的 `Live half-state sweep`(run 43390711926)绿,job 13m22s。复审余两个 nit,不再移 head。

## What changes

`OWNERSHIP_MARKER_NEAR_MISS_FORMS`' `leading-sigil` member spelled its sigil run as a repeated group that starts with a sigil and may also swallow the next one: `(?:S[S, marks]*[ \t]*)+`. On a line that is a long symbol run with no `Claim`/`Release` after it, V8 tries every way to split the run before it refuses. The same language is now spelled unrolled, `S C*(?:[ \t]+S C*)*[ \t]*` (S = `So/Sm/Sk/Sc`, C = S plus `Mn/Me/Cf`), so each blank run must be followed by a new sigil and there is one way to split any line. A docblock paragraph states why the nested spelling is refused.

BATTERY68 gains three cases. A 28-sigil pin must be refused in under 250 ms. Only if it passed are the long shapes (the 40-`─` rule on #32929, 40 backticks, 40 sigils under a bullet, 4,000 `═`) evaluated, and they must name nothing in under a second; otherwise that case reports `NOT RUN` and goes red by name, so the gate cannot hang. A control checks that a 40-sigil run in front of `Release:` is still named `leading-sigil`.

`.github/workflows/half-state-patrol.yml`: `timeout-minutes: 15` → `25`, with an eight-line comment giving the measured job durations and a ⛔ against raising the cap to turn a hang green (a hang shows as the sweep step running past twice its usual time with no `check-half-states exited` line).

## Why

The card read the cancellations as board growth. Measurement says otherwise, so this is neither arm of the dispatch fork (cap raise or smaller read). The seat accepted that as a recorded deviation, and separately chose to raise the cap because the slowest green run already sat 58 s under the old one.

- A local live sweep made 25 requests in 11 s, then none, at ~96% CPU. Three debugger pauses all stopped in `ownershipMarkerNearMissCensus` at `form.re.exec(line)`.
- #32929 comment 6840027098 carries four lines of 40 `─` (U+2500, `So`). The nested spelling's cost doubles per sigil; at 40 it is far past any cap, so a cap raise alone could not fix it.
- Every one of the file's 73 exported regexes was run on 28-char runs of 21 hostile characters with 4 line prefixes. Only `leading-sigil` was slow. After the fix, none was.
- Job durations, all 43 green runs 2026-10-30 → 2026-11-09: slowest 14m02s (run 41076277250); the census step 4m01s–5m55s in the 42 ordinary runs.

## Tests

- `node scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs --self-test`: exit 0, `5256 cases pass`, including the three #32991 cases.
- Ablation: only the old regex put back, `--self-test` exits 1 after about 4 s with two of 5,256 cases failing by name (the pin and the `NOT RUN` long-shape case).
- Equivalence, old vs new regex, comparing the matched prefix (or no match): 13,630 string-literal lines from the file itself, 17 hand cases, and 300,000 seeded random strings over a hostile alphabet. 313,647 compared, 0 differences.
- `Live half-state sweep` on this PR: run 43390711926 green on head 0b448a73, job 13m22s, sweep step 6m22s.

## Acceptance notes

- Changeset: none. `scripts/pm/**` and `.github/workflows/**` are unpublished, so this carries the `skip-changeset` label.
- Governed path: `.github/workflows/half-state-patrol.yml` is Tier H by content (the workflow holds a secret or a write token). `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` is outside the reduced-read arm the claim allowed; the seat accepted that as a deviation.
- Known limits (not held against this PR): sibling boards pinned to an older sha keep the hang until they re-pin; a long leading blank run still costs quadratic time (predates this PR, candidate card).

## Verification

`Lint · repo & tooling gates` ran the self-test: 5,256 cases, about 1.3 s. `Live half-state sweep` run 43390711926: success. Change set: 2 paths, +40/−2. Main merged once (c54a23d2) before opening; K = 12 at handover.

</details>
